<!-- Thanks for contributing to dsh-fast! Please complete the checklist below before requesting review. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] All CI gates pass (typecheck, test, coverage, lint, build, verify:self-contained, verify:artifacts, README sync, pack)
- [ ] Added or updated tests
- [ ] Updated `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] Synced the multi-language READMEs (`README.md` is the source; `README-zh.md`, `README-es.md`, `README-pt.md`, `README-hi.md` must match)
- [ ] Linked the related issue (if any)
- [ ] Confirmed no secrets, tokens, or keys are included in this change
